text:
alex: Heads up — our staging cut scheduled for 11:00 PT is blocked. e2e runner queue is saturated; I’m seeing a flurry of `artifact download timeout` errors from the new build. CI dashboard: https://ci.redwood/internal/runs/98765

maria: Ugh. same artifact store throttle we hit last week?

jen: Running quick grep of the last 50 job logs — lots of 504s from the object proxy. snippet:
```
ERROR: failed to fetch artifact //artifacts/redwood/service:98765.tar.gz: read tcp 10.0.0.12:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-21T09:03:12Z proxy: rate limit exceeded for client project-42
```

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for staging: queue_length=72, avg_wait=3m45s. Auto-retry backoff in effect.

sam: We have a 2-hour change window until 13:00 PT. Options: (1) Pin to last-green image (sha:abc123) and promote now, (2) Requeue higher-priority smoke subset only, (3) Wait it out and risk missing window / rollback later.

alex: I prefer pin+promote if smoke passes. The full e2e run will take too long.

maria: Agree. We should also file a follow-up to investigate object proxy throttling so this doesn’t keep happening.

eng-release-manager: Quick checklist before we pin: 1) Confirm last-green sha (jen) 2) Run smoke suite (deploy-bot / sam) 3) Post a rollback plan in the release notes if any regressions appear. If smoke is green within 20m, we promote and cut. Otherwise we abort the cut and escalate to infra.

jen: Last-green is sha:abc123 (build 98710). I kicked off the smoke subset against abc123 just now: https://ci.redwood/internal/runs/98710/smoke.

sam: deploy-bot queued the smoke jobs with priority=high. current status: 3/6 running, no failures yet.

alex: Perfect. Also add a note in the release notes draft: "Pinned to previous stable artifact due to transient artifact proxy errors; follow-up investigation in infra tickets."

deploy-bot: Smoke subset finished: 6/6 passed. Manual promotion link: https://deploy.redwood/promote?image=sha:abc123

eng-release-manager: Decision: Promote sha:abc123 now to keep the change window. We will not rollback while infra investigates unless we see critical regressions. Filing infra ticket: INFRA-2314 (artifact proxy throttle).

maria: Thanks everyone. After promote, let's schedule a short postmortem and add rate-limit metrics to the CI dashboard. :thumbsup:

alex: Promo initiated. Will monitor for any errors and post updates here.

jen: Adding the rollback snippet to release notes and tagging docs: `rollback: docker pull ghcr.io/redwood/service@sha:abc123`

sam: If infra reports this as recurring, we should consider fallback to our cold-cache mirror for artifacts as an interim mitigation.

eng-release-manager: Noted. Closing this thread once promotion completes successfully; leave a comment here if anything flares.

alex: Promotion finished and smoke health checks look clean. Closing."
